title: Standup Writer
description: Combine change, calendar and task evidence into a standup draft.

assignments.task: Summarize supplied commits and verified task changes, separating completed work from ongoing work.
Combine the change summary with calendar and tasks into yesterday/today/blockers, with source links.

fields.label: Execution mode
fields.help: Use draft for read-only preparation. Use apply to enable the review checkpoint and approved changes. Each side effect still follows policy.

instructions: Read supplied recent commits or an approved official MCP reader, plus scoped calendar.list and todoist.list where configured. Do not infer completed work from an unmerged branch or a calendar title alone. In apply mode post only the reviewed standup to a configured Slack/Discord account or official destination with Writer grants.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Supply commit evidence or an official reader and any task/calendar accounts. Posting needs an explicitly scoped channel.
approvalPoints: Posting to a team channel is approved for the exact destination and text.
limitations: Native GitHub does not list commits; use the supplied change feed or a reviewed official MCP reader.
